plain_english: In the heart, Kāma wakes to kill. This — the separated beloved — arises.
sanskrit_cite: manmathe ca hṛdi hantum udyate proṣitapramadayedam udyate

plain_english: By that cruel one who serves a foreign land, you will kill me — without him.
sanskrit_cite: nirdayena paradeśasevinā māriṣyatha hi tena māṃ vinā

plain_english: Release your foreign love today — or your wife: what more is there to say?
sanskrit_cite: anyadeśaratir adya mucyatāṃ sāthavā tava vadhūḥ kim ucyatām

plain_english: The cātaka, gasping, begs for rain — and nothing else. The suffering traveler — she is your beloved.
sanskrit_cite: cātakaś ca tṛṣito 'mbu yācate duḥkhitā pathika sā priyā ca te

plain_english: By clouds the peacock-flock is sounded; what delight, beloved, without me today?
sanskrit_cite: ambudaiḥ śikhigaṇo vinādyate kā ratiḥ priya mayā vinādya te

plain_english: Thinned by cloud-arrival, she today; tormented by hard Kāma.
sanskrit_cite: toyadāgamakṛśā ca sādya te durdhareṇa madanena sādyate

plain_english: Drowned in sorrow-ocean's water; remembrance of your virtue alone keeps her afloat.
sanskrit_cite: śokasāgarajale ca pātitāṃ tvadguṇasmaraṇam eva pāti tām

plain_english: The rivers' water melts the impurity. Why do you regard me, wretched as I am?
sanskrit_cite: dravati ca kaluṣaṃ jalaṃ nadīnāṃ kim iti ca māṃ samavekṣase na dīnām

plain_english: Pained by deep cloud-rasa — when, friend, shall I be free of this burning, born of separation from my beloved?
